checks.name: zip-install-chain
checks.scope:
Execute actual TWinstall_zip -> mapped package -> ZIP/verifier/digest -> updater.

Native x86_64 builds of the current AOSP ZIP and TWRP sources run in a private
chroot with ordinary files and locally generated test keys. Actual BoringSSL
host archive and AOSP host libbase/log/libc++ are hashed dependencies. Property,
DataManager/progress and unmount are doubles. ABI-named updaters contain host
code solely to check selection; no ARM64/OTA payload/GUI/sideload/device run.

checks.name: zip-selection-updater-regression
checks.scope:
Execute production ZIP updater command, fork/exec pipe parser and child wait.

The compiled host updater only emits protocol/creates a private marker. Real
fork, execve, pipe, stdio and waitpid execute; pipe/fork/fdopen failure injection
is explicit. Progress sink is checked, logs are captured. No package extraction,
ZIP signature/digest verification, payload/OTA engine, device or USB execution.
